themes_detail.label: Commercial Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Commercial noise complaints spiked to 43 reports last week—a 106% increase over the 8-week average of 20.9 per week—suggesting a sudden surge in disruptive business activity or enforcement gaps in Crown Heights this week.
evidence: 43 commercial noise complaints filed last week vs. 20.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 3.52)
106% spike represents statistically significant deviation from baseline
No corresponding context in community board agendas or local news coverage to explain cause
reporting_angles: Interview residents in high-complaint blocks; map where complaints cluster (restaurants, music venues, construction?)
Request 311 complaint details to identify specific businesses and complaint types (music, HVAC, late-night service?)

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Six complaints about illegal tree damage were filed 2 weeks ago—a 500% spike over the 8-week average of 1.0 per week—suggesting possible coordinated tree removal, construction damage, or emerging environmental enforcement issue in the district.
evidence: 6 illegal tree damage complaints filed 2 weeks ago vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.47)
500% spike indicates concentrated incident or pattern, not gradual increase
Aligns with CB budget request history for 'Reconstruct or upgrade building in a park' suggesting ongoing park infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Identify which parks or blocks had tree damage; visit sites to assess damage and interview residents
Cross-reference with DOB permits (22 alteration/new building filings in last 90 days) to determine if construction is linked

themes_detail.label: Traffic Complaint Acceleration
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints jumped to 6 filings last week—a 336% increase over the 8-week average of 1.4 per week—indicating a new or worsening street safety or congestion issue this week.
evidence: 6 traffic complaints last week vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.16)
336% spike is statistically significant and recent
No corresponding news coverage or CB discussion identifying cause, suggesting emerging rather than chronic issue
reporting_angles: Request detailed 311 complaint descriptions to identify type of traffic issue (accidents, congestion, illegal parking blocking lanes, speeding)
Canvas residents and local businesses on major corridors (Atlantic Ave, Nostrand Ave, Classon Ave) about recent changes

themes_detail.label: Electrical System Failures
themes_detail.summary: Three electrical complaints filed 2 weeks ago represent a 700% spike over the 8-week average of 0.4 per week, suggesting potential grid strain, faulty wiring in aging buildings, or a localized electrical hazard in Crown Heights.
evidence: 3 electrical complaints filed 2 weeks ago vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.42)
CB budget requests include 'Assign additional building inspectors,' indicating historical concern about building system oversight
reporting_angles: Determine location of electrical complaints; interview residents about service outages, fires, or safety concerns
Contact DOB and Con Edison about recent electrical incidents, building violations, or infrastructure work in the district

themes_detail.label: Hazardous Materials Alert
themes_detail.summary: Five hazardous materials complaints filed 3 weeks ago represent a 471% spike over the 8-week average of 0.9 per week, with asbestos complaints also up 300% during the same window, raising concerns about unsafe demolition, renovation, or environmental contamination.
evidence: 5 hazardous materials complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.9 weekly average (z-score: 5.28, severity: high)
3 asbestos complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.8 weekly average (z-score: 3.4, 300% increase)
Both spikes occurred in same timeframe, suggesting coordinated source (demolition project, renovation, industrial release)
FRESH Pt. 2 Atlantic Ave development project filed and in 'Project Readiness' phase—potential remediation work
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings or sites triggered asbestos and hazmat complaints; determine if demolition or renovation work was underway
Contact DOH, EPA, and Con Edison about air quality testing, contamination reports, and whether public notification occurred
Investigate FRESH Pt. 2 Atlantic Ave project timeline and whether site remediation has begun
